nonClaims: This CLI does NOT prevent npm from pruning the root node_modules through a junction. npm is unchanged. FN-u12-root-preinstall-runs-after-reify still holds: npm 11.6.2 runs the root preinstall after arb.reify, so no lifecycle hook can protect the root. The protection is the loop convention - every lane shell sets npm_config_dry_run=true and no lane runs an npm lifecycle in a junctioned worktree - plus a caller that runs this CLI BEFORE any npm command.
No preinstall wiring. package.json gains one script key and nothing else; scripts.preinstall is still absent and the pin asserts it.
Nothing in the repository calls this CLI yet. The worktree-setup step and the lane-charter convention that name it are the parent's WORKERS.md / GOAL.md docs change, not this unit's.
No e2e row, no Playwright run, no exact-main regression ladder run, no build. Only jest, tsc, oxlint, oxfmt, lint:units, the openspec CI validator and the roadmap validator were run.

Directory symlinks cannot be created on this machine without elevation (measured: EPERM from fs.symlinkSync for 'dir', 'file' and the default type; 'Administrator privilege required' from PowerShell New-Item -ItemType SymbolicLink). The 'planted as a symbolic link' case therefore ran against a junction here and is a real symlink only on POSIX, where fs.symlinkSync(..., 'junction') is an ordinary symlink. The POSIX symlink branch is proven by POSIX CI, not by this machine.

npm's behaviour was not measured in this unit: no npm install, ci, prune or any npm lifecycle was run anywhere. The only npm invocations were npm run for lint:units, qc:openspec-ci:validate and qc:guard-node-modules-link, with npm_config_dry_run=true set in the shell throughout.

findingsReportedNotFixed.summary: The manifest refusal reason word changed from the parked module's manifest-outside-cwd to manifest-root-mismatch, which is the word this unit's contract names. Any external consumer that grepped the parked draft's word would need updating - there is none in the repository (grep for manifest-outside-cwd matches only the U12 receipts, which are historical records and were left as they are).

The refusal line carries an {expectedPath, actualPath} JSON tail after the reason word. That is the parked grammar and it is useful to an operator, but it means a caller matching on the whole line rather than the first two tokens is coupled to path formatting. The pin matches the whole line; a caller should match the reason word.

The guard reads and JSON-parses the manifest only to decide that it is readable; it does not look at any field in it. If a later unit wants the manifest's name or workspaces honoured, that is a widening, not a fix here.
npx jest scripts/__tests__ takes 584 s on this machine in band. A lane that runs it as a routine gate should budget ten minutes, or run only the focused pin.
